ask: can u make a checklist of who paid the $10 so jalen can use it at the door
sentence: A door checklist for a fixed cover charge where the host marks each person and their guests as paid, and members can say they sent payment.
use_when: Collecting a flat cover charge from a group before an event
A host needs a paid or not paid list to check at the door
Guests want to say they sent money so the host can verify it
People are bringing plus-ones who also need to pay
dont_use_when: Splitting a bill or shared expenses by amount owed
Collecting different amounts from each person or taking real payments in the app
Counting RSVPs or yes/no attendance with no payment
